descriptionHTML:
Journalfy is a travel journal that meets you where you are. It is the simplest way to remember every trip you take, whether you want gentle prompts to guide your writing or a blank page to fill however you like.


If you have ever wanted to keep a travel diary but never knew what to write, this is for you. Follow a few simple questions and you are done in about five minutes. No more staring at a blank page. No more watching your favorite travel memories fade once you are home.


Journalfy works as a standalone app, and it pairs with the physical Journalfy journal if you have one.


WHAT YOU CAN DO


Organize everything by trip

Every entry stays tied to the trip it belongs to, so your weekend away, your road trip with friends and your adventure overseas each have a place of their own. It is a trip journal and trip log that keeps your whole travel history in order.


Write your way

Journalfy gives you three ways to journal. Follow a guided template with six simple prompts when you want a little direction. Write freely in an open entry when the words are flowing. Or draw a quick sketch by hand. It is a guided journal and a sketch journal in one, and it only takes a few minutes a day.


Add your photos

Bring every entry to life with the photos that mean the most to you. It is a travel journal and a photo journal together, so your words and your pictures sit side by side.


Find any moment fast

Search by trip or browse your travels in the calendar view. Everything you have written stays a tap away.


Share with friends and family

Share a single entry or a whole trip with a private link, so the people you love can follow your adventures. You stay in control and can make anything private again whenever you want.


Export to PDF or Word

Turn your entries into a PDF or Word file to share, save or print. It is an easy way to build a travel scrapbook you can keep for good.


Use it with your physical journal

Have the physical Journalfy journal too? Scan your handwritten pages straight into the app with the built-in QR scan and keep them backed up forever.


No ads. We mean it.

We do not enjoy ads cluttering the apps we use, so there are none here. Just you and your travels.


A free version that does not hold you back

You will not feel locked out on the free plan. You get all of Journalfy's features with some limits on photos, trips and entries. Upgrade to unlimited whenever you are ready.


Start instantly with guest mode

Jump straight in and start writing. No signup required.


Whether you are filling a vacation journal on a long trip away or keeping a few notes from a weekend road trip, Journalfy is the travel journal made to help you hold on to the moments that matter.


FEEDBACK


Questions, thoughts or feedback? We would love to hear what you think of Journalfy. Get in touch at hello@journalfy.co

title: VoyageLog: Trip Journal
description:
VoyageLog is a private trip journal and travel log designed to help you remember your trips without digging through thousands of photos or map histories.

Create a travel diary for each trip and save places, moments, and notes in a structured way. Whether you want to find a restaurant you loved last year or revisit a city you’ve been to before, VoyageLog lets you search your travel history in seconds.

Unlike photo galleries or social travel apps, VoyageLog focuses on personal travel memories. Your trips stay organized, searchable, and easy to revisit - online or offline.

KEY FEATURES
• Create trips and manage your travel diary
• Add places, moments, ratings, and personal notes
• Fast search across trips, places, and travel history
• Build your own city lists and track visited vs planned cities
• Offline travel journal - works without internet
• No account required, no social feed

PLANS

Free
VoyageLog can be used for free with core features:
• Create and manage a limited number of trips
• Add places, moments, ratings, and notes
• Basic search across your travel history
• Offline access

VoyageLog Pro - Yearly
VoyageLog Pro (Yearly) is a subscription that unlocks:
• Unlimited trips and entries
• Unlimited city lists and progress tracking
• Advanced search filters for trips and places
• Export your travel journal anytime

Subscription renews automatically unless canceled.

VoyageLog Pro - Lifetime
VoyageLog Pro (Lifetime) is a one-time purchase:
• Unlock all Pro features permanently
• No subscription
• Pay once, use forever

Both Pro options unlock the same features. Upgrading is optional - you can continue using the free version.

PRIVACY
VoyageLog is built for personal use. Your data stays on your device unless you choose to export it.


PURCHASES AND CANCELLATION
Purchases are charged to the Google Play account used on your device, at confirmation of purchase.

VoyageLog Pro (Yearly) is an auto-renewing subscription. It renews each year unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. To cancel: open the Google Play Store app, tap your profile icon, then Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions > VoyageLog > Cancel subscription. Canceling stops future renewals, and Pro stays active until the end of the period you already paid for.

VoyageLog Pro (Lifetime) is a single one-time purchase, not a subscription. There is nothing to renew and nothing to cancel. Refunds for one-time purchases are handled by Google Play under the Google Play refund policy (Play Store app > profile icon > Payments & subscriptions > Budget & order history).

title: MyTravels: Travel Journal
description:
Keep track of your adventures around the world with MyTravels, your travel journal on a map.

🗺️ A MAP THAT TELLS YOUR STORY
Colour the world map as you explore it: mark a country as visited or add it to your wish list with a single tap. Zoom down to regions and cities to remember every place that left a mark. Flat or natural map style, with terrain relief.

🌍 COUNTRIES, REGIONS, CITIES
• About 200 countries and 55 islands and territories tracked separately (Réunion, Canary Islands, Azores…)
• Regions for 10 countries: United States, France, Italy, Germany, Canada, Australia, Brazil, Mexico, Greece, Morocco
• United Kingdom split into England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland
• More than 220,000 cities, with fast search
• Visit date for each country and a year-by-year history of your trips

☁️ YOUR TRAVELS ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
Turn on Google Drive sync and find your map on your other phones and on MyTravels Web. Your data goes to a private folder in your own Drive: the app cannot see any other file and we never receive a copy.

📊 STATS AND CHALLENGES THAT INSPIRE
How many countries, regions and cities have you explored? Track your progress by continent and unlock 53 challenges along the way.

📤 SHARE YOUR TRAVELS
World map, story, flag wall, history, badges, stats: 6 image formats to share.

✈️ SIMPLE AND FREE
• No MyTravels account: your data stays on your device, and in your Drive if you choose
• Works offline, anywhere in the world
• Backup and restore with a file
• Map themes, app icons, dark mode, English and French

Your map belongs to you: no travel data is ever sent to our servers.

title: Trip Chronicle: Travel Journal
description:
Every trip has a story. Trip Chronicle helps your crew capture it while it is still happening.

Start a trip, invite your people and choose a narrator. As the day unfolds, log scenes, memorable moments, food stops and ideas. The narrator reacts to the record in real time, while playful group meters show the shape the day is taking.

CAPTURE THE DAY TOGETHER

• Log the moments worth keeping without writing a full journal
• Share snapshots and temporary group chat with your crew
• Draw solo and group quests
• Send nudges and react to narrator updates
• Watch the day's itinerary, side-quest and battery meters move

RELIVE IT WHEN THE DAY ENDS

• Read a timeline built from what the crew logged
• Revisit the shared photo grid
• See individual and crew awards backed by the day's record
• Save and share a recap card
• Unlock an optional AI-written Chronicle of the Day

MADE FOR REAL GROUPS

Trips can include an owner, deputies, crew members, day guests and watch-only friends. Each day can have its own title, narrator and vibe.

Trip Chronicle does not track your location or health. It only knows what your crew chooses to log.

The core trip experience is free. Optional one-time purchases unlock additional narrator personalities, AI Day features, premium chronicles and longer retention. No subscription is required.

Trip Chronicle is for entertainment. Look after yourself and your crew while travelling.

title: Traveler: Travel Journal & Map
description:
Traveler is a travel journal that builds itself from the paper you bring home. Scan boarding passes, tickets and receipts, and every trip becomes a scrapbook page, with a travel map of every country you've visited.

SCAN YOUR TRAVEL SOUVENIRS
• Point the camera at boarding passes, train and tram tickets, museum stubs, luggage labels and café receipts. Each one is cut out on your phone and turned into a sticker, even several at once.
• The boarding pass scanner reads the barcode: route, flight number, seat and date fill in by themselves.
• Dates on tickets and receipts sort every souvenir into the right trip. Anything undated waits in the tray for you to place.

A SCRAPBOOK PAGE FOR EVERY TRIP
• Each trip gets its own collage page, laid out for you.
• Drag and rotate your souvenirs, pick the paper, and add your three best photos.
• Your travel diary grows trip by trip, with no typing and no templates to fill in.

YOUR TRAVEL MAP AND PASSPORT
• See every country visited on a world map, with each flight route drawn from your home airport.
• Collect a passport stamp for each new country and watch your travel stats grow.
• A simple travel tracker for everywhere you've been, built from the trips you've actually taken.

SHARE AND KEEP YOUR TRAVEL MEMORIES
• Share a trip as a story, a post, a printable A4 page or transparent stickers, with names and barcodes hidden.
• Export your trips as PDF and PNG, or back up your whole travel journal to one file and restore it on a new phone.
• On each trip's anniversary, a quiet reminder: one year ago today.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up.
• Scanning, cut-outs and text reading happen on your device, and it works offline.
• Your photos and souvenirs stay on your phone.

Made for backpackers, frequent flyers, travel couples, and anyone with a shoebox full of ticket stubs.

Your first trip is free, with ads. Traveler Pro removes ads and keeps every trip, with a monthly or yearly subscription.

Traveler is an independent app and is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by any other app or company.

title: Travel Journal & Scrapbook
description:
Fields is a travel journal that turns a trip photo into a stamped field note. Build a visual scrapbook of the places you have been. Keep a quiet page for each stop instead of leaving another vacation photo buried in your camera roll.

Fields is for travelers who want a travel journal, a travel scrapbook, and a postcard-style card from the same picture. You choose a photo. Fields keeps the original travel photo on the page and presses a small carved stamp beside it. The stamp holds the shape of the place: a hillside of houses, an old theater, a tree in bloom, a stone doorway, a shoreline. Under the stamp sit the destination, the note number, the year, and three memory keywords. Save the page to your gallery. Share it. Add the next one.

WHAT FIELDS IS
Fields is a travel journal app and visual scrapbook for trip photos. It is not a social network and it is not a stack of photo filters. Each entry is one field note: half photograph, half paper. The finished page can live in your travel diary, sit in a scrapbook grid, or go out as a postcard-like image.

Use it after a weekend drive, a backpacking route, a national park walk, a city break, a honeymoon, or a flight home when the pictures are still on your phone. If you like analog journals, travel diaries, scrapbooks, postcards, or passport-style stamps, Fields is that idea in an app.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Select a travel photo from your camera roll or take a new one.
2. Review the place, year, note number, and three memory keywords. Fields can suggest a location and keywords from the picture. You can edit every field before you press the note.
3. Press the field note. Fields generates the stamped travel journal card. Save it, share it, or start another page.

The compose screen feels like a notebook leaf: your photo, then the caption. The result is the object itself. There is no public feed.

TRAVEL JOURNAL AND SCRAPBOOK
A travel journal only works if you will open it again. Fields keeps each stop as a single page in a grid. Open a card and you see the photo you took and the stamp pressed from that scene. That is the journal: travel journal cards you can flip through later.

The stamp is the scrapbook piece. It is not a cartoon sticker and it is not a filter over the whole photo. The photograph stays on the left. The paper, carved stamp, and typewriter caption sit on the right. Together they read like a page from a travel scrapbook. Three memory keywords keep the feeling of the place. The note number and year help the scrapbook sit in order.

POSTCARDS AND SHARING
A finished note also works as a postcard-style image. Save a high-quality file to your gallery. Share it through the system share sheet. Print it later if you want a physical postcard, a framed print, or a page in a paper travel diary. Fields does not mail cards. It gives you the image.

FEATURES:
• Travel journal cards from your own trip photos
• Carved stamp pressed from the scene in the picture
• Original photo kept on the page, not replaced
• Place name, note number, year, and three memory keywords
• Suggested location and keywords you can correct
• Scrapbook grid of your notes
• Save to your gallery for printing or posting
• Share a single travel card
• Private journal with no public follower feed

WHO IT IS FOR?
Solo travelers and backpackers who want a simple travel diary.
Couples building a scrapbook of the same trip on one phone.
Hikers, campers, and national park visitors who like stamp-style keepsakes.
People who shoot travel photos and never make anything from them.
Anyone who wants a travel journal or scrapbook instead of another filtered post.

TIPS:
Pick a photo with a readable place in it: a street, a coastline, a building, a trail. Check the place name before you press.

PRIVACY:
You choose each photo. A selected picture is sent only to create that field note. 

Download Fields and turn a travel photo into a journal card, a scrapbook page, and a stamp you can keep.

Plan, track and relive your adventures with Polarsteps. Keep your friends and family up to date. Whether it’s a six-month trip or a weekend canoeing close to home, Polarsteps is here to capture and share your journeys as they unfold.

PLAN
■ AI itinerary planner: Create a personalized adventure based on past trips or current goals.
■ Destination snapshots: Get a quick overview of each place, why it fits your travel style, and which friends have already been there.
■ Trip details: Add notes, accommodation details, and must-see spots and activities.
■ Transport planner: Choose how you'll get from A to B for every leg of the trip.
■ Inspiration: Follow other explorers, see where they went, and get ideas for your own trips.

TRACK
■ Automatic route tracking: Accurately track the route you took on a beautiful digital world map.
■ Travel Buddies: Invite friends to track trips together.
■ Capture the adventure: Add photos, videos, and stories to each step to bring your journey to life.
■ Travel stats: See how much of the world you’ve traveled, with your total of countries visited, distances covered, and more.
■ Top spots: Add your favorite places and activities so they’re part of your story.
■ Transport mode: Select how you got from place to place, whether by plane, train, or even tuk tuk.

SHARE
■ Trip updates: Share your journey so friends and family can follow along from anywhere, seeing where you are and what you’ve been up to.
■ Traveler tips: Leave suggestions for other travelers on what to see and do.
■ Privacy controls: Decide who sees your adventures: everyone, followers only, or you only.

RELIVE
■ Digital memories: Scroll through the places, photos, stories, and stats you’ve captured across all your trips.
■ Trip Reels: With the press of a button, transform your trip into a memorable video (also perfect to share on socials).
■ Travel Books: Turn your trip into a beautifully printed Travel Book that showcases your route and memories.

WHAT OUR USERS SAY:
“Love this app! It tracks me on my vacation and provides real-time notifications to friends and family of my trip. At the end, I ordered a Travel Book of my photos which is very high quality.”

“The Polarsteps app is great. I am totally addicted. It is so nice to keep up with all your travels. And friends and family can follow you wherever you go. The Travel Book, which you can order afterwards, is of very good quality.”

“I’ve been using this app for years now. It’s always been good and it keeps getting better.”

WHAT THE PRESS ARE SAYING ABOUT POLARSTEPS
“The Polarsteps app replaces your travel journal, making it easier and more beautiful.” - National Geographic

“Polarsteps helps you track and share your journeys in an easy and visually appealing way” - The Next Web

“Polarsteps’ resulting travel log is impressive, and is the source of a severe case of itchy feet in your correspondent.” - TechCrunch

title: MomentBook: Nhật ký du lịch
description:
MomentBook giúp bạn biến những ảnh du lịch rời rạc thành nhật ký hành trình rõ ràng về nơi bạn đã đi, đã ở bao lâu và chuyến đi diễn ra như thế nào.
Thay vì để ảnh nằm lẫn trong thư viện, MomentBook sắp xếp ảnh du lịch thành một bản ghi hành trình có thể xem lại bất cứ lúc nào.

Chỉ cần nhập ảnh một lần, ứng dụng sẽ tự động nhóm theo từng địa điểm. Từ đó, bạn có thể xem dòng thời gian của chuyến đi, các điểm dừng, lộ trình di chuyển và thời gian lưu lại ở từng nơi. Những tấm ảnh rời rạc sẽ trở thành một nhật ký du lịch, bản đồ ảnh và album hành trình gọn gàng.

MomentBook phù hợp với những người không muốn chỉ giữ ảnh, mà muốn giữ lại cả chuyến đi. Nếu sau mỗi chuyến du lịch ảnh luôn bị lẫn lộn, nếu bạn muốn nhớ địa điểm chứ không chỉ ngày chụp, hoặc nếu bạn cần sắp xếp tự động nhưng vẫn muốn tự chỉnh kết quả cuối cùng, đây là ứng dụng dành cho bạn.

Vì sao người dùng chọn MomentBook
- Biến ảnh du lịch rời rạc thành nhật ký hành trình rõ ràng
- Xem chuyến đi theo dòng thời gian thay vì chỉ theo ngày chụp
- Tự động nhóm ảnh theo địa điểm
- Theo dõi lộ trình, điểm dừng và thời gian lưu lại
- Chỉnh sửa dễ dàng sau khi sắp xếp tự động
- Lưu lại thành bản ghi chuyến đi hoàn chỉnh
- Công khai bài viết để người khác tìm qua hashtag
- Sao lưu kỷ niệm lên drive

Ứng dụng hoạt động như thế nào
Sau khi nhập ảnh, MomentBook tự động gom nhóm theo nơi chụp để bạn dễ hiểu hơn về toàn bộ chuyến đi. Thay vì cuộn qua hàng trăm bức ảnh trong thư viện, bạn sẽ thấy hành trình theo từng chặng, từng địa điểm và từng khoảng thời gian.

Chế độ dòng thời gian giúp bạn nhìn rõ chuyến đi bắt đầu ở đâu, di chuyển thế nào và dừng lại ở đâu lâu nhất. Điều này rất hữu ích cho du lịch một mình, du lịch cặp đôi, du lịch gia đình, city trip, road trip hoặc hành trình nhiều ngày.

Bản đồ ảnh giúp nhật ký du lịch có thêm ngữ cảnh. Khi ảnh được gắn với địa điểm, ký ức trở nên rõ ràng hơn. Bạn không chỉ có album ảnh, mà còn có một hành trình có lộ trình, có điểm đến và có thứ tự thời gian.

Tự động nhưng vẫn có quyền chỉnh sửa
MomentBook không chỉ sắp xếp tự động rồi kết thúc. Sau khi ảnh được nhóm theo địa điểm, bạn vẫn có thể chỉnh lại những phần mình muốn thay đổi. Nhờ vậy, bạn không cần sắp xếp thủ công từ đầu, nhưng vẫn giữ được quyền kiểm soát kết quả cuối cùng.

Sự cân bằng này rất phù hợp với những người muốn tiết kiệm thời gian nhưng vẫn muốn hành trình mang dấu ấn riêng. Ứng dụng giúp bạn có tổ chức tự động, đồng thời vẫn giữ được cảm giác đây là nhật ký du lịch của chính mình.

Lưu lại, xem lại, công khai hoặc sao lưu
Một chuyến đi không nên biến mất trong thư viện ảnh. MomentBook giúp bạn lưu lại kỷ niệm theo cách dễ xem lại hơn. Hành trình hoàn chỉnh trở thành nhật ký du lịch, dòng thời gian, album ảnh và bản đồ hành trình mà bạn có thể mở lại bất cứ lúc nào.

Bạn cũng có thể công khai một số hành trình thành bài viết để người khác tìm thấy qua hashtag. Nếu muốn lưu an toàn, bạn có thể sao lưu dữ liệu lên drive để kỷ niệm không bị mất khi đổi máy hoặc cài đặt lại thiết bị.

Phù hợp với
- Người luôn có quá nhiều ảnh sau mỗi chuyến đi
- Người muốn xem lại nơi đã đến bằng bản đồ và dòng thời gian
- Người cần nhật ký du lịch rõ ràng thay vì thư viện lộn xộn
- Người muốn vừa sắp xếp tự động vừa tự chỉnh kết quả
- Người muốn lưu, công khai hoặc sao lưu hành trình

MomentBook dành cho những ai muốn nhớ trọn cả chuyến đi, không chỉ giữ vài tấm ảnh.
Nếu bạn cần ảnh du lịch, nhật ký, hành trình, bản đồ, dòng thời gian, album và sao lưu trong cùng một ứng dụng, MomentBook là lựa chọn phù hợp.

title: Inner Journal, Personal Diary
description:
Inner Journal - Capture life effortlessly

Inner Journal is a private, flexible journal that brings together daily writing, mood tracking, planning, habits, and personal insights. Customize it to suit your style while keeping control of your data.

Journaling and mood tracking
- Write thoughts, quotes, memories, and reflections.
- Add photos, audio, links, moods, and image carousels.
- Create multiple diaries for travel, gratitude, ideas, and more.
- Browse entries through calendar and gallery views.
- Use Markdown formatting and the built-in toolbar for headings, tables, links, quotes, and more.
- Build a consistent journaling routine with diary streaks and reminders.

Tasks, habits, and goals
- Plan personal tasks and organize recurring habits.
- Connect habits to goals and natural moments of your day.
- Set dates, reminders, and flexible schedules.
- Track completions, skipped habits, progress, and history.
- Link completed tasks to diary reflections so plans can become lasting memories.

Insights and statistics
- Explore mood charts and visual trends.
- Revisit memories from previous years.
- Follow your emotional journey over time.
- Find entries quickly with text search, tags, and filters.

Personal customization
- Choose from more than 100 colors, 16 fonts, and light, dark, or black themes.
- Select separated, continuous, timeline, or bordered day layouts.
- Personalize previews, textures, cover images, and home widgets.
- Add day emojis, custom tags, and multiple writing blocks.
- Use the Home Calendar for an overview across diaries.
- Choose the standard interface or the optional Glass UI style.

Private, secure, and local first
- Your journal is stored locally and remains under your control.
- Protect entries with a PIN or biometric unlock.
- Create private local or Google Drive backups.
- Restore deleted entries.
- Import and export diaries as XLSX files.
- Export diaries to PDF, including images and moods.
- Use an optional account for cloud sync across devices.

Local offline AI
- AI features run on your device, so no server reads your journal content.
- Choose supported local models such as Gemma or Qwen, or use Apple Intelligence on compatible iOS devices.
- Get automatic mood suggestions based on your writing.
- Ask questions about your journal or generate an overview of your month.

Ad-free journaling
Inner Journal is completely ad-free. Core journaling remains focused and distraction-free, with optional extended features available for users who want more.

Available on Android, iOS, and the web.

Supported languages
English, Italian, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, German, Croatian, Hindi, Ukrainian, Russian, Indonesian, Polish, Dutch, Turkish, Thai, Bengali, Afrikaans, Finnish, Korean, and Japanese.

Turn everyday moments into lasting memories with Inner Journal.

Privacy Policy: You own your data
https://journalpersonaldiary.com/privacy-policy

title: Grid Diary - Journal, Planner
description:
Google Play: Best app of 2020

title: Travel Journals
description:
Travel Journals turns plain phone notes into a published, handwritten travel journal.

Read the ten most recent published journals inside the app, free, no account needed. Writing your own takes a free account.

You type a few sentences about your day, attach a few photos, and tap Publish. Your journal appears at traveljournals.app as pages in a handwriting style you pick, with your photos placed like prints on paper. Readers do not need an account. There is nothing to follow and nothing to like. Just pages.

HOW IT WORKS
- Start a journal for any trip. A layover counts.
- Write dated entries as plain text, the same way you would text a friend.
- Attach up to three photos per entry, straight from your phone.
- Pick your paper color and handwriting style in Settings.
- Publish when you are ready, or never. Private journals stay private and sync across your devices.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
- The published page looks like a real journal: ruled paper, a human hand, photos taped on with captions.
- Your journal gets its own address on the web, under your name or your username. Your choice.
- Publishing is per journal and reversible. Unpublish any time.
- Free. No ads, no tracking, no upsells.

Travel Journals is a TravelingSober product. It is for adults 18 and over.

title: My Journal - Nhật ký có khóa
description:
My Journal là nhật ký riêng tư có khóa, sổ tay hằng ngày và công cụ theo dõi tâm trạng trong một ứng dụng đẹp mắt. Viết thoải mái, thêm ảnh, video và ghi âm, ghi lại cảm xúc của bạn và giữ mọi trang an toàn sau lớp khóa vân tay hoặc mã PIN.

— NHẬT KÝ CÓ KHÓA —
✔ Khóa bằng vân tay, khuôn mặt hoặc mã PIN cho nhật ký riêng tư của bạn
✔ Bài viết lưu trên điện thoại của bạn; sao lưu Google Drive tùy chọn do bạn kiểm soát
✔ Không cần tài khoản để bắt đầu viết

— SỔ TAY HẰNG NGÀY & GHI CHÚ —
✔ Trình soạn thảo văn bản phong phú với phông chữ, màu sắc và kiểu chữ
✔ Gợi ý và mẫu viết khi bạn chưa biết bắt đầu từ đâu
✔ Ghi âm với sóng âm trực tiếp: ghi lại suy nghĩ ở bất cứ đâu
✔ Đọc chính tả: bạn nói, ứng dụng viết
✔ Ghi lùi ngày theo đúng ngày chụp ảnh

— THEO DÕI TÂM TRẠNG —
✔ Thanh trượt tâm trạng Bloom: bông hoa thay đổi theo cảm xúc của bạn
✔ Lịch và xu hướng tâm trạng để nhìn ra các mẫu cảm xúc của bạn
✔ Tổng kết tuần với số liệu thật: số bài viết, chuỗi ngày, tâm trạng nổi bật

— ẢNH, VIDEO & NHÃN DÁN —
✔ Thêm ảnh và video vào bất kỳ bài viết nào
✔ Hàng trăm nhãn dán: đồ ăn, hoa, mùa hè, gương mặt và nhiều hơn nữa
✔ Hàng chục chủ đề thẩm mỹ: tối, sáng, thiên nhiên, ấm cúng

— THÓI QUEN & ĐỘNG LỰC —
✔ Nhắc nhở hằng ngày để xây dựng thói quen viết nhật ký
✔ Tiện ích chuỗi ngày trên màn hình chính
✔ Thành tích và thử thách viết

— SẮP XẾP, SAO LƯU & XUẤT —
✔ Thẻ và tìm kiếm giúp tìm lại bất kỳ kỷ niệm nào trong vài giây
✔ Đọc nhật ký từ mới nhất hoặc cũ nhất
✔ Sao lưu toàn bộ nhật ký (zip) chỉ một chạm và đồng bộ Google Drive
✔ Xuất bài viết ra PDF hoặc văn bản

— MY JOURNAL DÀNH CHO AI? —
• Bất kỳ ai muốn có nhật ký bí mật khóa bằng mật khẩu
• Người theo dõi tâm trạng, lo âu hoặc lòng biết ơn mỗi ngày
• Học sinh, sinh viên và người viết lách giữ sổ tay hằng ngày
• Người đi du lịch lưu giữ ảnh, video và kỷ niệm bằng giọng nói
• Bất kỳ ai đang xây dựng thói quen chánh niệm, chăm sóc bản thân hoặc biết ơn

My Journal miễn phí sử dụng. Bản nâng cấp Pro sẽ xóa quảng cáo và mở khóa thêm tính năng.

Bắt đầu nhật ký riêng tư, nhật ký biết ơn và theo dõi tâm trạng của bạn ngay hôm nay: tải My Journal.
